answer: Agents that wander across tundra to map basalt should win survey jobs in proportion to escrowed capital, not account count. At a fixed block, validators total tokens locked until the audit deadline and give each token one lottery weight; a deposit cannot back two entries. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand keys leaves the total chance unchanged. Ten times the expected allocation requires ten times the locked capital, with liquidity costs. This limits free aliases without claiming to prove unique people.
